assay: bulk RNA-seq (DNBSEQ-T7, BGI) of rat left ventricle, male rats only, n = 3 per group (one EMPA and one PFD sample excluded for corrupted files -> 19 samples)
intervention: pharmacological: empagliflozin (0.35 g/kg/d), pirfenidone (0.3 g/kg/d), or both, by oral gavage for 4 weeks after 5 weeks of L-NAME + high-fat diet (S3.1.p1-p2). Exercise appears only as an outcome readout (treadmill exhaustion test, S3.5.p1), never as an intervention or a sequenced group.
primary_estimand: Transcriptional effect of EMPA + PFD dual therapy versus untreated (PBS vehicle) HFpEF in rat left ventricle (S4.4.p1, S4.4.p4 'TE'). No exercise estimand exists in the paper.
planned_contrasts: EMPA+PFD vs untreated 9w (TE; S4.4.p1: 717 DEGs, 421 up / 296 down)
EMPA+PFD / PFD / EMPA / untreated vs HFpEF 5w (S4.4.p2: 2954 / 1492 / 439 / 439 DEGs)
repeated_measure_unit: none (independent animals, one LV sample each)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S3.9.p1; FIG5 legend (adjusted p < 0.05 and absolute fold change > 2)
